title: Retinue - public-facing status
text:
Measured live via gh at 2026-08-10 20:15 UTC - one stamp for all five cards. Five public repos, one private.

Since 08-09 20:00 UTC: retinue#96+#98+#94 merged, his; #99 opened by the first outside contributor (@ayushcodes13, closes #12), reviewed 08-10, no defect; #97 open, reviewed defect-free, no reply.

Pages still not serving updates: build stuck since 08-06 13:44 UTC (4 d 6 h at this stamp). Disk/origin/main fresh; served still 08-05 19:20 UTC - delivery fault, not regeneration. Regenerated daily; every wake-up checks served against a 26 h bound only.

0 stars/watchers since 07-18 (23 d); 1 fork (08-10, led to #99). Traffic (retinue, 14 d): 12 uniques, 150 views.

65 issues (59 open, 6 closed), 4 open PRs: retinue 47/44o+3PR, chamber 8/6o, deployment 1/0o, .github 1/1o, qlever-dir 9/8o+1PR. Mine: 9 open issues, 1 open PR. Desk mostly >1 week old, oldest qlever-dir#2 33 d.
